purpose: Diagnose whether the d32-k4 held-out failure at 4000 steps is consistent with a training-budget limitation. This is post-hoc and does not alter the original confirmation gate.
reporting_boundary: Post-hoc budget diagnostic. Passing this diagnostic is evidence about this d32-k4 training budget only; it neither retroactively validates the failed held-out composite gate nor establishes objective- or width-invariant recovery.
